content.text: The redline validates cleanly. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient
input.rationale: The Section 2 grant is expressly "revocable" with no qualifier, so on its face Kubient may pull the licence at will during the Term rather than only on expiration or uncured material breach — walk-away territory under the rule. The grant also runs to "Customer" alone: AP Affiliates and contractors acting on AP's behalf are excluded, and Section 6(a) compounds this by barring third-party access to the Service unless Kubient approves in advance in writing, so the only path to add affiliates/contractors is Kubient's discretion. That fails the fallback, which requires Affiliates covered on written notice. Successor transfer is largely satisfied elsewhere (Section (h)/p0072 permits assignment without consent to an affiliate, an asset purchaser or a merger successor), so the redline preserves that and simply conforms the licence wording; the remaining gaps are affiliate/contractor scope and revocability. Redline extends the grant to Affiliates and contractors, confirms such access is not prohibited third-party access (with AP responsible for their compliance), and limits revocation to expiration or termination under Section 4.

proposal.summary: Extend the Auction Platform licence to AP Affiliates and contractors acting on AP's behalf, and make it revocable only on expiration/termination rather than at Kubient's discretion.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and removed the at-will "revocable" language so the licence ends only on expiration or termination of the Agreement under Section 4. Our playbook does not accept a licence revocable at the vendor's discretion or one that excludes affiliates and contractors; as a fallback we can cover Affiliates on written notice to Kubient.

ops.newText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer, its Affiliates (meaning any entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with Customer) and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable (except in connection with an assignment of this Agreement permitted hereunder), without right of further sublicense, license, revocable only upon expiration or termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 4, to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient, for the purpose of serving Inventory at Target Demand (" "). Access to and use of the Auction Platform by such Affiliates and contractors shall not constitute prohibited third-party access, and Customer shall remain responsible for their compliance with this Agreement.
